full_judgment: 2. Relevant facts are summarized as follows: Plaintiffs filed the aforesaid title suit for a declaration of title and confirmation of possession or in the alternative for recovery of khas possession of the suit land on the allegations that they as benamdar of the judgment-debtors auction purchased a jote which included 5.33 acres of tenanted land under Khatian No. 99 standing in the names of Panchy Sheikh, Kamaruddin Sheikh i.e. the father of defendant Nos. 1 and 2 and Ramjan i.e. the father of the defendant Nos. 3 and 4 in Rent Execution Case No.1035 of 1930 arising out of Rent Suit No. 607 of 1930 on 20-1-1931 and took delivery of possession thereof on 2-5-1931 after having annulled the encumbrance namely, the said under-tenancy by service of notice under section 167 of the Bengal Tenancy Act. Father of defendant Nos.1 and 2 late Kamaruddin Sheikh having admitted annulment of the said under-tenancy took fresh settlement of some of the said under tenancy by executing kabuliayat. But due to mistake 2.30 acres of land of the said under-tenancy was wrongly recorded in the names of the defendants during SA settlement and by taking advantage of such wrong recording the defendants threatened the plaintiffs with dispossession from the said land on 21st Chaitra 1373 BS. Hence the plaintiffs were constrained to file the suit.
